matches.rationale: Finding 1 points to the same root cause: generateRandomNonce builds nonces from block properties and previous state, so they can be predicted. It also names the nonce-collision DoS impact.
No report finding mentions revert strings versus custom errors.
No report finding covers owner-only pause/unpause as a centralization risk. Finding 13 is about upgrade authorization, which is a different function.
Finding 7 covers emergencyWithdraw, but its defect is the missing whenNotPaused check. It does not raise the risk that an unrestricted owner can drain funds.
